validation.method: Scan (no text layer): tables read by eye from 200-dpi page images, tesseract only as a draft; every page's part numbers were also compared with the OCR draft (differences were OCR misreads, none in the transcription).
validation.refContinuity: Continuous except these gaps, as printed (no numerical index in this book to confirm them): cylinder_block ref 3; flywheel_crankshaft_pistons ref 5; cylinder_head refs 4 and 22 (list opens with an unnumbered KIT row, then ref 2); rocker_shaft refs 13 and 14; timing_gear_camshaft refs 8, 17, 18 and 22; camshaft_case_throttle_linkage refs 8, 18-20, 32 and 33; fuel_injection_system refs 7 and 22; hydraulic_lift_assembly ref 26. Repeated refs are L.H./R.H. pairs, alternates, undersizes, sizes and shims. Body ref 11 on the base page printed as '1' and was corrected. 32 unnumbered rows kept (assemblies and their sub-parts, tires, rims and bearings, mounting hardware).
validation.quantities: All rows have a qty; 53 are UAR. REQ'D printed out of register only on the electrical system page (42 rows mapped in sequence, counts equal, flagged 'inferred qty'). Tail wheel tire prints qty 8 under a 1-wheel assembly: kept and flagged.
validation.numericalIndex: None. The table of contents lists parts-list sections only and no numerical index is in the PDF (pp88-90 are blank); the operator's manual has only an alphabetical subject index. No index comparison was possible, so no index-vs-table differences exist.
validation.partNoForms: Perkins P + 9 digits stored as printed (source perkins); Case letter prefixes closed up (C45367); hardware codes stored 'NNN-NNNN' (113-104); printed forms kept in partNoAsPrinted. NSS rows (no part number printed) carry the NSS flag. No * / ** part cells are NSS; the 62" drive * / ** part numbers are real and carry serial variants.
